description: Product and industry concordances with versioned code namespaces: Census 2026 import (HTS) and export (Schedule B) 10-digit concordances to HS6, NAICS 2022, SITC Rev.4 and end-use; WITS HS2017->SITC Rev.3, HS2022->SITC Rev.3 and HS2012->ISIC Rev.3; UNSD HS2022<->HS2017 and HS2017<->HS1992 conversion and correlation tables

source.publisher: U.S. Census Bureau (Foreign Trade Division); World Bank WITS; United Nations Statistics Division
source.license_notes: Census concordances: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). WITS concordance extracts: World Bank WITS terms of use (derived from UNSD tables); keep internal and cite WITS/UNSD, verify before redistribution. UNSD correlation tables: UN terms of use, free use with attribution. Records carry a per-row licence attribute.

sampling.criteria: No sample adapter: seven small files are acquired in full

acquisition.description: impconcord26/expconcord26 (latest published year, 2026; NAICS 2022 basis verified against the NAICS 2022 code list), WITS Concordance_H5_to_S3/H6_to_S3/H4_to_I3 (no H5/H6->ISIC archive exists), UNSD HS2022toHS2017 and HS2017toHS1992 tables
